name: DeathSpectateRun
note: L_CombatTest, ADR 0004 C11 (task m4-followups/04). 5 s warm-up (2 s standing, 3 s strafing so the pre-death corrections are judged by FireRun's rule), then the server kills the pawn (serverKill: ServerKillSelfTest, environment damage = suicide). The dead client enters the free-spectate state (AVeloxSpectatorPawn, engine 4 Hz ServerSetSpectatorLocation) without input; infra/ci/nettest.sh starts the server with velox.combat.ForceRespawnDelay 4, so the forced respawn ends the spectate after 4 s. The script ends 0.5 s after the kill; the client then waits for the new pawn and quits 1.5 s after it (VeloxNetSoak event=respawn_seen).
